summary: First full regression pass on StayOS V1 (NestJS API + Next.js web). Backend: created /app/tests/stayos_regression_test.py (53 pytest cases) covering auth for all 7 seeded roles, permission gating, cross-property isolation, guests CRUD, rooms/availability, the full reservation lifecycle (create -> guest-registration -> identity -> payment-review -> check-in -> folio -> extend -> move-room -> add charge -> payment -> receipt PDF -> checkout), billing lists/overview, housekeeping assign->start->complete->inspect round-trip, staff-access token enable/regenerate/disable, settings + all report endpoints. 51/53 passed (96%). Frontend: exercised login for 5 roles, wrong-password handling, route gating, /reservations list, Availability Calendar, full new-booking creation end-to-end (new guest + Mantine date range + room type + payment timing -> booking detail HS260801-00051), Check-In Workspace (OCR upload tiles + face-match card + blockers), Extend Stay modal, Move Room modal (options populated), Stay Workspace, /billing folio detail (Add Charge / Collect Payment / Settle Folio), Housekeeping Board + Staff Access modal (QR/Copy link/Regenerate/Enable-Disable), /settings/users, /settings/employees, /settings/room-types, /reports, /guests/new. Core staff workflows are functional; 2 backend defects and 7 frontend defects found, none blocking the primary booking->check-in->billing->checkout path.

critical.issue: FRONT_DESK role returns 403 'Insufficient permissions'. role-permissions.ts UserRole.FRONT_DESK has no HousekeepingView/HousekeepingManage/EmployeesView. Requirement says Front Desk must access /housekeeping. The web sidebar still shows a Housekeeping link (with badge) for Front Desk, so the board loads empty with two 403s in console — a real staff-blocking mismatch.

Returns HTTP 500 with code RAZORPAY_NOT_CONFIGURED. /app/stayos-api/.env contains NO RAZORPAY_KEY_ID / RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET (grep returned nothing), contradicting the brief that test keys are pre-configured. Cannot obtain a Razorpay order_id. Also a config-missing case should be 503/501, not 500.

minor.issue: Invalid / regenerated / disabled tokens return 400 VALIDATION-style error instead of 401/403/404. Behaviour is safe (access denied) but the status code is non-standard for a token-gated public route.

Pagination param is `limit` and forbidNonWhitelisted rejects `pageSize` with 400. Not a bug, but list endpoints return `data` as a bare array while guests/reservations return `{items,...}` — inconsistent list envelope across modules.

ui_bugs.issue: Housekeeping nav item is rendered for FRONT_DESK but the page then fires two 403s and shows an empty board. Either grant housekeeping.view to FRONT_DESK or hide the nav item.
Permission leak: HOUSEKEEPING and FRONT_DESK users can open /settings and see the settings tiles (Room Types etc.). Requirement: Owner/Admin only. /billing is correctly gated for housekeeping.

Developer/debug copy is shipped in the production UI: 'Demo data: run npm run bootstrap:demo-employees. Demo manager user: Gaurav Gaur, gaurav.gaur@stayos.local, MANAGER, Password123!' — leaks a plaintext password to any manager/owner.

Modal opened via the 'Move Room' button is titled 'Assign Room' with a primary button 'Assign Room' and placeholder 'Choose a ready room'. Confusing for a room-move on an in-house guest (options themselves load correctly: 'Room 307 - Deluxe', 'Room 308 - Deluxe').
Date of birth uses the native browser date input (renders mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the Mantine DateInput used elsewhere — inconsistent UX and US date order in an INR/India property.
Contradictory payment state: header badge says 'Paid' and the Payment card says 'Paid', while the action banner says '₹11,760 to collect' for the same reservation (HSDEMO-0022).
For a booking created with arrival 2026-08-26 the banner reads 'Guest is expected today. Assign a room to continue.' — wrong day copy.

Old check-in screen is still routed and fires two 404 GETs on /properties/:pid/reservations/:id/... producing console errors. The real OCR/face-match workspace lives at /reservations/:id/check-in. Remove or redirect the legacy route.
React console error: 'Encountered two children with the same key' (duplicate keys in a chart/list map). Page still renders KPIs (Occupancy 6.25%, Revenue ₹79,392, ADR ₹1,764, RevPAR ₹110).
Nationality shows 'International' while the guest record and booking detail both show 'Indian' — field mapping bug.
Language chips render both 'Hindi' and 'हिन्दी' as separate options — duplicate language entry.

Testability gap: email input, password input and Sign In button have no data-testid (only forgot-password-link does). Mantine TextInput renders type='text' so input[type=email] selectors fail; automation must fall back to role/label.

integration_issues.issue: GET housekeeping/dashboard + employees return 403; board renders with no rooms and console errors.
403 from /reservations and /guests is rendered as a generic server-outage screen ('Try Again / Check Server Status') instead of an access-denied message.
Order creation 500s because Razorpay keys are absent from stayos-api/.env, so the online-pay path is unusable end-to-end.

issues: Native date picker for Date of birth (mm/dd/yyyy) mixed with Mantine pickers elsewhere
Dev instructions + plaintext demo password shown as page copy
Several CHECKED_IN rows show Room = 'Unassigned' (seed data inconsistency) which reads as a data error to staff

action_items: Decide and fix the housekeeping permission model for FRONT_DESK: add Permissions.HousekeepingView (+ EmployeesView for the staff modal) to UserRole.FRONT_DESK in /app/stayos-api/src/core/auth/role-permissions.ts, OR hide the Housekeeping nav item and route for FRONT_DESK.
Add RAZORPAY_KEY_ID / RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET to /app/stayos-api/.env (they are currently absent) and return 503 instead of 500 when the gateway is unconfigured.
Gate /settings (and /settings/*) to Owner/Admin only — HOUSEKEEPING and FRONT_DESK can currently open it.
Remove the dev/demo instructional block (with the plaintext Password123!) from /settings/employees.
Rename the Move Room modal title/CTA from 'Assign Room' to 'Move Room' for in-house stays.
Fix the Paid vs '₹11,760 to collect' contradiction on BookingDetailPage and the 'expected today' copy for future arrivals.
Replace the native Date-of-birth input in CheckInWorkspacePage with the Mantine DateInput.
Remove/redirect the legacy /check-in?reservationId= page which 404s twice.
Fix duplicate React keys on /reports and the 'International' nationality mapping in the Stay Workspace.
critical_code_review_comments: role-permissions.ts: FRONT_DESK lacks HousekeepingView while the web nav unconditionally shows Housekeeping — permission model and nav config are defined in two places and have drifted.
Razorpay service throws a 500 for a missing-configuration condition; configuration errors should map to 503 and be surfaced as a disabled UI affordance rather than a runtime failure.
List envelopes are inconsistent: rooms/room-types return data as a bare array, guests/reservations return {items,...}. Clients must special-case per module.
Public token route housekeeping/staff/access/:token returns 400 for invalid/revoked tokens; use 401/404 so clients can distinguish malformed input from revoked access.

check-in blockers are enforced server-side (guest registration, identity verified, payment reviewed, room READY) — good; the legacy /check-in page bypasses this UI and should be deleted to avoid two divergent check-in flows.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (all routes render; 12 UI/permission defects, core booking->check-in->billing->checkout path works)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite: `python -m pytest /app/tests/stayos_regression_test.py -p no:randomly -q`. Two expected failures until fixed: TestPermissionGating::test_frontdesk_can_access_housekeeping_board (403) and TestReservationLifecycle::test_13_razorpay_order (500, keys missing). Playwright notes: login inputs have NO data-testid and Mantine renders email as type=text — use page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Email') + input[type=password] + button 'Sign In', and use .fill() (keyboard.type drops the first char). DatePickerInput is a button, not an input — click page.get_by_text('Select arrival -> departure') then pick days in .mantine-Popover-dropdown table. Avoid wait_until='networkidle' (times out); use domcontentloaded + explicit waits. Real check-in workspace is /reservations/:id/check-in (has checkin-* / id-photo-* / face-* testids); /check-in?reservationId= is a legacy page that 404s. Stay workspace is /guest-stay/:reservationId. Not yet covered: OCR upload with an actual JPEG (fixture /app/tests/fixtures/sample-id.jpg does not exist), CheckoutModal submit through the UI (checkout verified via API only), /guests/:id/edit and guest history pages, /rooms/:roomId status toggle via UI, and the public /housekeeping/staff/access/:token page in the browser (token flow verified via API).
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Front Desk housekeeping 403: UserRole.FRONT_DESK in role-permissions.ts omits HousekeepingView/HousekeepingManage/EmployeesView while the Next.js sidebar renders the Housekeeping entry for all operational roles, so the guard denies a nav target the UI advertises. 2) Razorpay 500: RazorpayService validates RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET at call time and throws an unmapped internal error; grep of /app/stayos-api/.env shows neither key exists, so every order request fails. 3) /settings leak: the settings routes render without a permission check, relying only on nav visibility, so direct URL navigation exposes them to housekeeping/front-desk users.
